headline: Economists Expect Federal Reserve Interest Rate Decisions in Focus
summary: Expectations regarding Federal Reserve interest rate decisions remain a central focus for financial markets as analysts weigh potential policy adjustments against inflation data.
why: The Federal Reserve's benchmark interest rate dictates borrowing costs across the economy, influencing equity valuations, bond yields, and currency exchange rates.

impacts.name: US Treasuries
impacts.why: Shifting expectations around central bank rate paths directly alter bond prices and yields.

why_moved: Market participants adjusted portfolios in response to evolving macroeconomic indicators and anticipated central bank policy moves.
